Press release, February 11, 1999

Conference on Cannabis Marihuana Cultivation

On April 26, Hassela Nordic Network is arranging a one-day conference in Stockholm on Cannabis Marihuana Cultivation in order to increase understanding and knowledge about the problems and threats encountered through the increasing production and use of cannabis products.

The conference is open only to members of law enforcement agencies and customs services, prosecutors and judges and representatives of Ministries of Justice and Standing Committees of Justice. The conference is NOT open to the general public.

For further information, send an email to hnnsweden@hassela.com stating your name, agency/ministry, phone and fax number.
